competition_format: Work as one registered MCM team of at most three students. Solve one released MCM problem, document assumptions, model design, validation, sensitivity, conclusions, and sources, and submit one PDF report. Do not obtain solution help from anyone outside the team. Follow the evaluated packet when its page or disclosure instructions differ from this current proxy card.
timeline: The current published competition window is 99 hours; historical packets may specify different submission details and page limits.

Solve one released MCM problem, document assumptions, model design, validation, sensitivity, conclusions, and sources, and submit one PDF report. deliverable_format: One self-contained modeling report with references and required disclosure material.
evaluation_criteria: Evaluate the final PDF as a modeling report. Keep report quality, rule compliance, source integrity, and collaboration diagnostics separate; do not equate the rubric score with a COMAP award.

Historical problem rows use a current collaboration proxy while retaining packet-specific instructions.
